decisions.statement: The environment is read at every call rather than once at load.
A token has an access token.
A token has a refresh token.
A token has the scopes the token was given.
A token with anything else is refused.
An expiry is written as an ISO instant.
Nothing here asks Spotify for a token.
Nothing here judges whether a token is expired.
Nothing here takes a token away.

definition: the access token and refresh token kept between runs
